head: Nobody is
looking at
this screen.
body: It is still collecting. Still emitting. Still burning battery, for a user who switched apps ten minutes ago.

head: It does not mind
*an empty room
slides.caption: Backgrounding the app does not leave the composition. So the collection keeps running, the flow keeps emitting, and the ViewModel keeps working for nobody.

items.title: Plain collectAsState is the exception
items.sub: and it needs a reason in the review

items.title: Know what it costs
items.sub: an off-screen flow still pays for every emission

items.title: Check with the app backgrounded
items.sub: the leak is invisible from the foreground

head: Lifecycle is not
a thing you bolt
*on later
body: It is the difference between work that stops when the user leaves and work that quietly runs forever.
Default to the one that respects it.
